nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.description: Threat actor seeking unauthorized access to databases, containers, or servers.

nodes.label: Establish PostgreSQL Servers
nodes.description: Identify PostgreSQL servers that are reachable from the attacker's network position.

nodes.label: Enumerate PostgreSQL Configuration
nodes.description: Inspect or infer PostgreSQL access-control and network-allowlist configuration issues.

nodes.label: Trust Authentication Enabled
nodes.description: PostgreSQL is configured with trust authentication, causing connections to be treated as authorized without normal credential validation.

nodes.label: Overly Broad Source IP Range
nodes.description: A broad range of IP addresses is allowed to connect to the PostgreSQL server, potentially including the attacker's IP address.

nodes.label: Unauthorized PostgreSQL Connection
nodes.description: The attacker connects to the PostgreSQL server without valid database credentials.

nodes.label: Unauthorized Database Access
nodes.description: The attacker gains access to PostgreSQL databases and the data or database operations available to the connected account.

nodes.label: Identify Container Images
nodes.description: Locate deployed container images and the applications or components they contain.

nodes.label: Search for Container Image Vulnerabilities
nodes.description: Search container images and their application components for exploitable security flaws, particularly remote code execution vulnerabilities.
